title: Threshold work function
statement:
If metal B has twice metal A’s work function, how do their threshold frequencies compare?

[_]{a}

choices: B has twice the threshold frequency.
B has half the threshold frequency.
explanations: Threshold frequency is proportional to the work function.
The ratio of work functions suffices.

hints: The threshold photon energy equals the work function.
h is common to both metals.
Divide each work function by h.
solution: The threshold photon energy equals the work function. h is common to both metals. Divide each work function by h. Threshold frequency is proportional to the work function.
